title: MCP servers explained: the protocol connecting AI to everything

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: MCP servers are the backbone of AI integration, enabling seamless communication across distributed systems with low-latency, high-throughput protocols.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Traditional servers offer proven scalability, security, and compatibility with existing infrastructure—MCP is just a buzzword without real-world validation.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: MCP uses lightweight, encrypted messaging queues and supports real-time updates, making it ideal for AI-driven applications like autonomous systems and IoT networks.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Servers have decades of refinement, with robust failover, redundancy, and support from major cloud providers—MCP is untested and lacks industry backing.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: MCP isn’t replacing servers—it’s evolving them, adding intelligence and adaptability where static infrastructure falls short.
